overview: Banking Open-API Partner Monitoring addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in banking and payments operations. The first proof of value uses API calls, consent grants, partner credentials and error logs. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is partner API breach and failure rate, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: partner API breach and failure rate

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: API calls, consent grants, partner credentials and error logs; define partner API breach and failure rate and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Payments / Chief Risk Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
